provenance: Independent synthetic DiagramML controls opened without repair, exported locally and saved by the native reference application. Both axes, reverse directions, zero/positive/factor/maximum/unbounded limits, inactive geometry-only height rules, exhausted endpoints, and a zero-effect cross-property consumer distinguish LIN fitting paths. Native geometry is an expected output only; regression trials are derived from authored constraints and dependencies. Integer model IDs are normalized by the native reference application on save; semantic text/depth and frames are retained. The first invalid synthetic builder with nonnumeric transition IDs was rejected and is not a source of these measurements. These controls contain SP leaves, not descendant TX content. Signed overlap/backtracking spacers and negative general variables were independently regenerated by the native reference application in a further eight controls.
